0022600125.text: The Houston Rockets (3-0, 1st in the Southwest, 2nd in the West) host the Atlanta Hawks (2-1, 1st in the Southeast, 4th in the East) in their fourth game of the season, with Houston on a three-game winning streak and Atlanta coming off a loss. Houston will be without Fred VanVleet (knee), Marcus Smart (forearm strain), and Steven Adams (ankle), while Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). The Rockets lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after sweeping the 2025-26 series 2-0, including a 121-114 win in Atlanta in their last meeting.
